100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 28, 1926, the United States faced a significant drought, prompting concerns over crop failures and water shortages in the Midwest. Internationally, the League of Nations continued discussions on disarmament, seeking to ease tensions in post-World War I Europe. In sports, American swimmer Gertrude Ederle made headlines as she prepared for her historic attempt to become the first woman to swim across the English Channel.
